title: System Integration Manager
desc:
Join Us
At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.
What You’ll Do
'System Integration
As system integrator manager you will be responsible for the interface between all Vendors and internal stakeholders ensuring a successful Software release. This includes:
Collaboration and Coordination of OpenRAN release schedules in conjunction with the OpenRAN vendors to ensure a timely delivery of Major and Minor releases
Foster a collaborative ecosystem to streamline communication and problem-solving across stakeholders
Close interaction with Vodafone Package and Release manager throughout the process
Governance of the 3rd Party System Integrators End-to-end testing (in vendor labs and 3rd Party SI environment) to validate functionality, performance, security and reliability representative of Vodafone deployments
Ensuring integration of hardware and software from multiple vendors to form a cohesive OpenRAN package
Ensuring interoperability of all OpenRAN elements, including radios, COTS, CaaS and network management systems
Interface verification to confirm adherence to open standards
Validation of OpenRAN readiness for commercial service, maintaining operational performance and reliability through robust system release management processes
Ensure availability of MOPs covering all aspects of the package and its deployable elements (Data Centre, RAN, etc)
Ensure that releases from vendors are of sufficient quality when GA status is claimed by vendors – managing commercial and contractual milestones associated to GA release
Influence and leverage collaborations through our technology, partners and OpenRAN industry forums for Product Integration best practices, Network Services, solutions, Support and E2E testing
Leverage automation tools - both internally and externally - for testing, deployment, and monitoring to enhance efficiency and consistency
Investigate and Champion ideas around Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD) practices to support ongoing integration and release cycles across vendors
Stay updated with the latest industry standards and best practices in OpenRAN, system integration, and release management
Future interoperability and compatibility of new OpenRAN components, such as RIC, SMO, etc
Drive Year on year cost reduction and process/platform efficiency improvements
Who You Are
'Core competencies, knowledge and experience:
5+ years of experience in system integration and release management, preferably in telecommunications
Strong contract and commercial understanding
Knowledge of OpenRAN technologies, standards, and interfaces
Proven track record of managing multi-vendor integration projects and complex release processes
Strong understanding of automated testing, deployment tools, and CI/CD practices
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to troubleshoot complex integration issues
Strong project management skills with the ability to handle multiple complex topics simultaneously
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with diverse teams
Key performance indicators:
Successful Integration of hardware and software from multiple vendors to form a cohesive OpenRAN package
Development of End-to-end System Integration methodologies
Development of robust, scalable systems for lab through to live development
Year on year cost reduction and process/platform efficiency improvements
Time to Fix Product Issues
Risk Management
No Direct reports: none but lead of virtual teams from vendors and other Vodafone teams will be essential to the role
